literal: things fit to be done / things that are not / by doing / will be ruined / things fit to be done / not doing / also by / will be ruined
translation: One will be ruined by doing what should not be done, and will also be ruined by not doing what should be done.
modern: செய்யத்தகாத செயல்களைச் செய்வதால் ஒருவன் அழிவான்; செய்யத்தக்க செயல்களைச் செய்யாமல் விடுவதாலும் அவன் அழிவான்.
explanation: This couplet warns against two paths to failure: wrong action and harmful inaction. The phrase 'செய்தக்க அல்ல செய' refers to committing acts that are unfit or inappropriate, which leads to ruin. Conversely, 'செய்தக்க செய்யாமை' points to the failure to perform necessary and proper actions, which is equally destructive. The repetition of 'கெடும்' (will be ruined) underscores the inevitable downfall that results from both errors in judgment.
